communications.subject: Charge inquiry - TXN-972850548
communications.body:
Hi,

I noticed a charge of $567.5 on my statement from Electronics Hub. I would like to understand this charge and request a resolution.

Regards,
Eleanor Vance

communications.subject: RE: Charge inquiry - TXN-972850548
communications.body: Multiple attempts to contact 'Electronics Hub' via their advertised customer service email (support@electronicshub.com) and phone number (1-800-555-0199) have been unsuccessful. Emails went unanswered, and the phone number appears to be out of service or disconnected.
